trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks automatically. It is the last trophy you will get, so the roadmap in this guide orders the other 54 to finish the grind in as few clean-up passes as possible. Nothing here is missable in a way a fresh playthrough cannot fix, so take the stages in order.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Gone Fishing'. It is an early story mission, so this is one of the first trophies you will earn; finish the mission and it unlocks on completion. If it does not pop, replay the mission and complete it again.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 of the story. This is unmissable story progress: it unlocks the moment the chapter's final mission ends, so just keep playing the main story. Do not go out of your way for it; it comes naturally in stage 1 of the roadmap.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable and unlocks when the chapter ends. Keep following the main story missions and it will pop on its own.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the story. Unmissable story progress, unlocked at the end of the chapter. Play the main story through and it arrives in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 of the story. Unmissable; it unlocks when the chapter's final mission is done. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is the last story beat, so it comes after every chapter trophy; finish the finale and it unlocks. Because it is story progress it cannot be missed — you will reach it by playing the main story to the end.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Breakfast Run'. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks on completion. If it does not pop, replay the mission and complete it again.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'The Cartel Heist'. A story heist mission — finish it and the trophy unlocks. Heist missions are long, so expect this one to take a while; completion is all that matters.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Child's Play'. Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks on completion. It is one of the named story missions, so it comes in order as you play the main story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Headliners'. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks on completion. Like the other named story missions, it is unmissable story progress.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'VCIA Takedown'. Finish the mission; the trophy unlocks on completion. The mission's name points to the airport (VCIA), so expect vehicle and combat set-pieces.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks on completion. It is a named story mission, so it arrives in order during the main story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long grind: story, stranger missions, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed the completion percentage, so it unlocks last, just before the platinum. Use this guide's roadmap and the in-game completion checklist to see what is left, and save it for the final clean-up stage.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and air tricks — the description's count is 250, so this is a long grind best done while exploring Leonida rather than in one sitting. Every stunt you complete counts toward the total, and the game tracks your progress.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game has a set of activity types (races, shooting range, fishing, arcade and more); sample one of each and the trophy unlocks. Do it early — it also shows you which activities you enjoy for the longer grinds.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the hardest activity trophy: you need gold, not just completion, on every one of the 42 challenges. Practise the range mechanics, learn each challenge's layout, and go for gold one challenge at a time — the range tracks your medals, so you can see which are left.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Drone races run at several locations around Leonida; you must win at least one race at each of them. Learn each course, then win them one by one — the race menu shows which locations you have already won at.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct race events count, so vary the races you enter rather than repeating one. Races are an activity type, so this pairs well with trying each activity for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the description names your rival, so this is a head-to-head fishing event. Fishing rewards patience: land your catches cleanly and watch Cal's score.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Visit an arcade, pick any game, and play it through to completion. Any arcade game counts, so choose the one you find easiest.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the stranger contacts with a mission strand; play his missions through to the last one and this unlocks on completion. Stranger strands are best done while working through the story, since they open up as you explore.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other stranger finals: finish Kenton's mission strand through its last mission and the trophy unlocks on completion.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's mission strand; the trophy unlocks when his final mission is complete. Work the stranger strands as you meet them and this comes in order.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions are the side quests marked on the map; finish eight full strands (each strand's missions, through its finale). The individual stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward this, so work the strands as you meet them.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's mission strand through its final mission. The trophy unlocks on completion of that last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's mission strand; the trophy unlocks on his final mission's completion.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are scattered around the state; visit each one and meditate there. Explore while doing the story and stranger missions, and use the map to sweep up any spot you missed at the end.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal — the description calls it unique, so it is a named target rather than any animal. Follow Bret's strand to find where the animal is, then hunt it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when you hold all its cards, and you need three full sets. Collect as you explore — the cards are the kind of thing best grabbed during story travel rather than hunted in one sweep.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK feature can be used at 100 spots around Leonida — use it at each one. This is a pure exploration count, so fold it into your map sweep for the other collectibles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; any 50 count. They accumulate naturally while you play — races, stunts, hunting and more all feed challenges — so this usually pops during the activity clean-up stage.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car and break line of sight; the partner must be with you when the wanted level drops.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row and keep the wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between robberies. Plan a route through three nearby shops and move fast.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or encounter 100 different vehicles — the game counts each new vehicle you discover. Just driving around Leonida and hopping into new cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you see them will build the count.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus (the game's slow-mo aiming) and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a busy firefight with enemies in the open, trigger it, and work through targets quickly.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At the airport (VCIA), leave in a way the game does not schedule — the description implies commandeering a plane and taking off. Head to the runways, grab an aircraft and get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description points to the Rhino tank: get into one and use it — the trophy is tied to driving or fighting in a Rhino. Tanks appear at military areas, so expect a wanted level when you take one.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan a quiet robbery: go in without alerting staff or cameras, take the goods and leave clean. If you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away after each one. Banks are the big heist-style robberies — plan your escape route before you go in, and expect a heavy police response.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape the police response. Trucks run set routes, so watch for one and strike when the road is clear.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the state — the trophy unlocks when the map is fully explored. Drive, fly and sail through each area; the map shows which parts you have not seen yet. Pair it with the collectible sweeps.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations; rob one belonging to each gang. Learn which gang holds which operation, then hit one of each.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot with a view, and order a cocktail. This is a free-roam moment trophy — it is there to be enjoyed whenever you are in the area.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car inside a vehicle showroom and drive it straight out through the glass — the 'classic style' is the smash-and-grab exit. Pick a showroom, get in a car, and floor it through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the description's 'follow-through' points to completing a bowling game there. Any completed game at that alley counts.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague, but it points to building your partnership's appeal with your partner — the kind of co-op goal the game tracks alongside the other partner trophies. Play partner activities together and work on the partnership goals the game shows you; the cited guides list it among the partner trophies.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). This is the choice trophy: at a story decision point, your choice has consequences, and the trophy marks that a choice was made. The description implies a specific decision, so it can be missed if you rush past it — keep a save before major story choices so you can return to the decision if needed.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description implies a second attempt at something — a retry that succeeds where the first try did not. Keep playing through the story and its set-pieces; if a moment asks for a second try, take it. Because the trigger is a specific moment, keep a save before big story beats.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description reads like a hidden or easter-egg moment — something strange you stumble on while exploring Leonida. Keep an eye out for odd events and locations off the beaten path; the cited guides list it as a secret-style trophy.
trophies.source: Exophase GTA 6 trophy guide; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, knock bowling pins over with a melee attack from the vehicle — the 'drive-by' is done with a melee weapon, not a gun. Find a bowling area, drive past, and swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money you clean through contacts; launder $250,000 in total. This accumulates across the game as you earn and clean bills — use your contacts regularly rather than letting bills pile up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 total in the game's shops — clothes, weapons, cars, food and more all count. It accumulates naturally as you gear up; if you are short at the end, buy big-ticket items.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage property available in the game. Properties cost money, so save for this one and buy them as you can afford them — the property menu shows which garages you still need.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles — ten of them. As you discover new vehicles, register them through the app.
